text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before the race, Silence Suzuka is taken aback by how much Mejiro Bright has visibly changed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yet, Silence Suzuka has also improved in their time apart.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Determined to shine the light of the Mejiros over the racecourse, Mejiro Bright steels herself for the autumn Tenno Sho.
